wholePhysicalScope: The 1837 letter supplies the outer stockade dimensions and single gate. Present archaeological-park boundaries, the interpreted barracks/store/school positions and quarters marker tie the reconstructed group to its general site.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the double enclosure, single entrance, slab barracks, cell block, work buildings and separate quarters. Near views add individual pointed poles, shingle courses and door hinges.
limitations: The present heritage markers approximate the historic building positions. Historic boundary registration, precise bay spacing, finishes and elevations are estimates.
Roof timber, openings, inner fence layout, detached service sections and individual terrain offsets are representative. Original ground is below later airport fill and is not reconstructed.
The model depicts the late 1830s establishment only. Modern memorial artworks, airport fabric, current interpretive buildings and archaeological displays are excluded.
